title: Onboarding Welcome mail
content:
When the default setup has been done send a mail to on-boarded persons with starting points and some high level information. Template for mail is outlined below but some information needs to be updated to match current product.

“Title: Welcome to REX DevOps tools for {Teamxyz}

Welcome! 

You have been on-boarded to Inter IKEA DevOps setup.

The first step is to set up access to the inter-IKEA GitHub Organization where REX is represented as IPEX team. Check here for instruction on how to get started, Access Inter-IKEA GitHub Organization  

When you have access see more information in your team welcome message in GitHub {deep link}

Best Regards

/DevOps Team”
